text:
[RDSC.8.3] Rule metadata is resolved by name, not by position. A
`rule_group`'s atoms reference a rule that a `TerminalNode` atom realizes, and the
runtime attaches `RuleCooldown` / `RuleSource` data to known rules in a
single pass once the network is assembled.

That pass is what makes the ordering in [RDSC.8.1] workable at all: a
`rule_group` is emitted **inside** its `module_group`, while `rete_network` is
bundle-global and arrives **after** every module group. So the metadata
precedes the terminals it names, and a reader that tried to attach it on sight
would fail on the first rule. It accumulates instead, and resolves at the end.

The name alone is the join: `TerminalNode` carries no `module_id`, and a rule's
name picks out one rule in an artefact ([LGRA.6.8]).
